portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

This update fixes the following bugs:

* The dasdstat data file with statistics is not compatible with the seek mechanism. Consequently, the dasdstat tool previously exited with an error message or reported inconsistent data. With this update, the data file is parsed without using seeks, and dasdstat prints the correct statistics as expected. (BZ#1186408)

* The qethqoat and qetharp tools previously did not display proper return codes. Now, the return codes are "0" when the command runs successfully and "1" when an error occurs. (BZ#1193549)

* Prior to this update, the ziorep tools could not parse the ziomon configuration file when using certain device BusIDs. All occurrences of device BusIDs in the ziorep tools have been fixed to support a full range of possible values. Now, the ziorep tools can process configuration files that use any valid device BusID. (BZ#1211979)

* When processing the dumpconf service, systemd no longer becomes unresponsive when the "DELAY_MINUTES" parameter is configured in the /etc/sysconfig/dumpconf file. (BZ#1247360)

* The "-d" option for the zfcpdump utility has been replaced by "-D", which allows SCSI dump operations to be performed correctly. (BZ#1247531)

* Prior to this update, the state of zFCP devices was not checked when bringing them online. Consequently, an error occurred for devices that were already online. This update adds an appropriate check, and errors no longer occur in the described situation. (BZ#1259822)

* Previously, the "lszfcp" command in some cases incorrectly displayed non-zfcp-host devices. This update corrects the filtering of the available SysFS paths, which ensures that "lszfcp" displays only zfcp-host devices. (BZ#1257064)

In addition, this update adds the following enhancements:

* Various tools have been enhanced to support a number of new IBM z13 hardware features, such as simultaneous multithreading (SMT), vector registers, or the CEX5S cryptographic adapter. (BZ#1182148, BZ#1182162, BZ#1182164, BZ#1182170)

* This update adds the lscpumf and chcpumf tools, which can be used to obtain performance data for Linux in logical partitioning (LPAR) mode. (BZ#1182188)

* The output of the "lsqeth" command now includes the switch port attributes. (BZ#1182286)

* This update adds the General Parallel File System (GPFS) as a supported partition type into the fdasd tool. This partition type identifies partitions containing GPFS Network Shared Disks (NSD) used to store GPFS file system information. (BZ#1182288)

* When used under the z/VM hypervisor, the hyptop tool now provides two new metrics: mgm (management time per second) and mgm+ (total management time). These indicate how efficiently the hypervisor communicates with the guest. (BZ#1182291)

* The "hmcdrvfs" command has been added, which creates a FUSE.HMCDRVFS file system at the specified mount point, and thus provides read-only access to files stored on an assigned DVD inserted in an HMC drive. Note that the feature works only in LPAR mode or on the z/VM hypervisor. (BZ#1182293)

* With this update, the zipl boot loader has been updated to a later upstream version, which enhances maintainability for Linux initial program load (IPL) code and enables easier inclusion of bug fixes and new features in the boot loader. (BZ#1182312)

* The dbginfo.sh tool is now capable of collecting information on libvirt, guest networking settings, and multipath configurations and logs. (BZ#1211276, BZ#1211283)

Users of s390utils are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which these bugs and add these enhancements.
